name: Slow
doc: Slow (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks), each a clock at the action's target's feet and a second layout under its effect point 0xF0, both turned with it and scaled by its size; a screen fade; the target blinks; when both layouts have finished the target takes the result. One of the two clock spell modules (123 Slow, 125 Haste: one source built twice).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layouts' blended vertex frames (after the three target nodes).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn; each target task's clock: its sound, the screen fade, the target's blink; both layouts' size (draws nothing); it ends when both layouts have finished

parts.title: Clock
parts.doc: The clock at the target's effect position, on its feet, turned with it

parts.title: Lower layout
parts.doc: The second layout under the target's effect point, turned with it

groups.label: Size
groups.doc: Both layouts scaled by ((the target's size >> 1) + Base) >> Shift (4096 = their own size)

groups.label: Blink
groups.doc: The target blinks over From .. From + Ticks - 1, on the ticks e % (Ticks - e) == 0 (e = tick - From; Ticks 0: never)

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the target tick == this

params.label: Fade tick
params.doc: The engine's screen fade starts when the target tick == this

tasks.doc: One per action: two layouts in frames of the action's target, turned with it, scaled by its size (only when the effect camera matrix's m[1][0] is not 0: the word Slow reads is never written), through the frame callback with every record flag it knows (0x100, 0x200, 0x1000: the effect camera matrix, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000) and the engine's renderer; its sound; it slows the target when both layouts have finished.
